content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip charge fees on every sale, ranging from 3.5% to 10%. This is a significant drawback for creators selling digital products, especially when they're already struggling to scale their businesses. In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack like the one you'll deploy here charges a mere 0.5% fee, courtesy of NOWPayments. This is a game-changer for creators who want to keep more of their hard-earned revenue.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few critical components. First, you'll need a domain name and a web hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, you'll need a payment gateway like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee. Finally, you'll need a delivery system like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will automate the delivery of your ebooks, templates, and fonts to customers. Don't worry if this sounds complex – we'll walk you through each step in detail.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Now that you have your components, let's set up your payment and delivery pipeline. First, create a NOWPayments account and connect it to your payment gateway. Next, set up your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script delivery system to automate the delivery of your digital products to customers. Finally, configure your payment settings to ensure that payments are processed correctly and delivered to the right place. This is the heart of your sovereign digital commerce stack – the place where revenue flows in and products flow out.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is the ultimate liberator for creators who want to own their own data, customers, and revenue streams.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

It's time to go live with your sovereign digital commerce stack. Start by publishing your website and making sure that all your links and pages are working correctly. Next, test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working as expected. Finally, process your first transaction and verify that the payment was successful. This is the moment of truth – the moment when you realize that you're in control of your own commerce infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Now that your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, it's time to scale. This means growing your customer base, increasing your revenue, and expanding your product offerings. To do this, you'll need to leverage the power of your infrastructure, using tools like the Complete Builder Kit to build, deploy, and scale your stack. Don't be afraid to experiment and try new things – the key to success is to stay agile and adapt to changing circumstances.

The most important question on every creator's mind is: How do I make money without relying on platforms that take a cut of my sales? The answer is simple: deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that charges a mere 0.5% fee, courtesy of NOWPayments. This means keeping more of your hard-earned revenue and scaling your business with confidence.

If you're looking for more ways to sell digital products without relying on platforms, check out our Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to help you build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also browse our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: Register a domain name and set up web hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Create a NOWPayments account and connect it to your payment gateway. Set up your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script delivery system to automate the delivery of your digital products. Configure your payment settings to ensure that payments are processed correctly. Publish your website and test your payment and delivery pipeline. Process your first transaction and verify that the payment was successful.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921 – a significant advantage for creators who want to keep more of their hard-earned revenue.
Can I use any payment gateway with NOWPayments?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee, making it an attractive option for creators who want to accept a wide range of payment methods.
How do I automate the delivery of my digital products?
You can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your digital products to customers, ensuring that they receive their purchases quickly and efficiently.
What happens if I encounter issues with my payment and delivery pipeline?
Don't worry – we've got you covered. Our customer support team is here to help you troubleshoot any issues and get back up and running as quickly as possible.
Can I use my sovereign digital commerce stack to sell physical products as well?
Yes, while this guide focuses on digital products, you can adapt your stack to sell physical products by integrating a fulfillment service and configuring your shipping settings.
